title: Sparky’s Secret Quest
moral: Being brave and clever helps you discover wonderful things.

scenes.summary: Sparky discovers a secret door in his treehouse.
scenes.text: Sparky the little dragon found a hidden door in his treehouse and decided to explore it.
scenes.image_prompt: cute dragon opening secret door in treehouse, magical glowing cartoon style

scenes.summary: Sparky enters a mysterious magical room.
scenes.text: Inside the door, Sparky found a magical room and felt unsure but curious about what to do next.
scenes.image_prompt: dragon in magical glowing room with stars and clouds, fantasy cartoon

scenes.summary: Sparky follows a path and meets challenges.
scenes.text: With help from Twinkle the fairy, Sparky followed rainbow stones and faced a challenge with a ticklish cloud.
scenes.image_prompt: dragon following rainbow path with fairy, fluffy cloud scene, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: Sparky solves the challenge by making the cloud laugh.
scenes.text: Sparky sang a funny song to make the cloud laugh and successfully passed the challenge.
scenes.image_prompt: dragon singing to laughing cloud, joyful magical cartoon

scenes.summary: Sparky finds the treasure and returns home.
scenes.text: Sparky found a glowing lantern treasure and returned home feeling brave and happy.
scenes.image_prompt: dragon holding glowing lantern treasure, cozy magical ending cartoon

story: Sparky the dragon found a hidden door in his treehouse and entered a magical room. He met Twinkle the fairy who guided him to find a treasure. Sparky followed rainbow stones and reached a ticklish cloud. He made the cloud laugh by singing a funny song and passed the challenge. At the end, he found a glowing lantern as treasure. Sparky returned home feeling brave and happy, ready for more adventures.
